def put(proto, x, y, d=Direction.UP):
    pos = P(x, y)
    try:
        if player_location.distance(pos) > 8:
            move_to(pos)
    except Exception:
        move_to(pos)
    try:
        e = place_entity(proto, position=pos, direction=d)
        return e
    except Exception as ex:
        print("FAIL", proto, x, y, ex)
        return None
def lay(points, step_dir_list=None):
    # points: list of (x,y) corners; lays belts along each straight segment, each tile pointing to the next tile
    tiles = []
    for i in range(len(points)-1):
        (x0,y0),(x1,y1) = points[i], points[i+1]
        dx = (x1>x0)-(x1<x0); dy = (y1>y0)-(y1<y0)
        d = Direction.RIGHT if dx>0 else Direction.LEFT if dx<0 else Direction.DOWN if dy>0 else Direction.UP
        x,y = x0,y0
        while (x,y) != (x1,y1):
            tiles.append((x,y,d)); x+=dx; y+=dy
    # last tile keeps last direction
    tiles.append((points[-1][0], points[-1][1], tiles[-1][2]))
    n=0
    for (x,y,d) in tiles:
        if put(Prototype.TransportBelt, x, y, d): n+=1
    print("laid", n, "of", len(tiles))
